description:
As a registered user
  I want to browse products, add items to my cart, and manage my cart
  So that I can purchase desired products

elements.name: Verify user can add an available product to the cart

steps.name: the user launches the application
the user logs in with valid username "sagesyntaxacademy" and password "BuildingExcellence@111" credentials
the user navigates to the products page
the user adds product "iPhone" to the cart
the user should see the success notification "Item added successfully🤗 !"
the user navigates to the cart page
the cart badge count should be 1
the product "iPhone" should be displayed in the cart
